title: AI Silhouette Art Generator
summary: Make silhouette art with AI: sunset silhouettes, paper-cut scenes, double exposures and Victorian profiles. Describe it, pick a style, and Flick makes it.
body_markdown:
### How do I make silhouette art with AI?


Describe a subject with a clear outline, a bright backdrop behind it and ask for every form in pure black with no interior detail, such as a girl on a swing against an amber sky, then pick a silhouette style and generate. In Flick you can then animate it into a clip.


### Can AI turn a photo into a silhouette?


Yes. Add the photo as a reference image and ask for the same pose as a pure black silhouette with crisp edges against a plain or sunset background, with no face or clothing detail inside the shape.


### What subjects work best for silhouette art?


Subjects with a distinctive outline work best: people in profile or mid-movement, animals with antlers or tails, trees, bridges and skylines, since a silhouette has no interior detail to explain what it is.


### Can I animate silhouette art?


Yes. Generate the silhouette first, then use it as the start frame of an image to video model in Flick and describe one gentle motion, such as water shimmering under a still figure, while asking to keep every shape pure black.


### Is the silhouette art generator free?


Yes, it is free to start with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6 runs on the free plan. Video models such as Seedance 2.5 need the Standard plan ($20 a month).
